name: Brainyak
description: A general brain-teaser assessment covering a broad mix of quick-fire cognitive challenges.

name: Logical Reasoning
description: Evaluates deductive and inductive reasoning through puzzles, sequences, and logic problems.

name: Memory Recall
description: Tests short-term and working memory through recall and pattern-retention exercises.

name: Verbal Reasoning
description: Measures the ability to understand, analyze, and draw conclusions from written information.

name: Palmistry
description: A lighthearted assessment exploring palm-reading style pattern interpretation.

name: Emotional Intelligence
description: Assesses the ability to recognize, understand, and manage emotions in yourself and others.

name: Metrics
description: Evaluates comfort with numerical data, measurement, and quantitative interpretation.

name: Spacial Intelligence
description: Tests the ability to visualize, rotate, and manipulate objects and spaces mentally.

name: Verbal Intelligence
description: Measures vocabulary, comprehension, and command of language.

name: Creative Assessment
description: Explores divergent thinking and original problem-solving ability.
